cn.t: Alvarez's meta-musical about the 1979 Greensboro Massacre draws mixed reviews. Critics praise its ambitious risk-taking and emotional honesty but fault its self-reflexive structure for obscuring the powerful historical story at its core.

vr.q: César presents a wide array of threads that make for a nonlinear experience, but an emotionally satisfying one nonetheless.
A lot of it really didn't work for me, but some of it definitely did.
